snippet.title: DE:VOID - Launch trailer
snippet.description:
A psychology horror game which explores the themes of life and death in a unique way. Help a girl in the capsule to find her memories and escape from a mysterious world.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173250/DEVOID/
Discord : https://discord.gg/2JJcngz

Available Languages:
- English
- Indonesia
- Japanese
- Simplified Chinese
